text.aria-label: Title text 'R-DW beats the lag-free L-1d by 0.2 to 0.35 points at every issue time at the eight. Dot: mean difference. Bar: 95% interval, 5 month blocks (near min to max). Line: same as L-1d.'
text.tspan: R-DW beats the lag-free L-1d by 0.2 to 0.35 points at every issue time at the eight.
Dot: mean difference. Bar: 95% interval, 5 month blocks (near min to max). Line: same as L-1d.
